title: Regret Analysis of Retry-Based Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2605.20854v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We provide the first regret analysis of ReMax in stochastic multi-armed bandits. Originally introduced for reinforcement learning, ReMax is motivated by the role of exploration when multiple attempts are allowed, and is closely related to retry-based objectives such as pass@$k$ and max@$k$, which value the best outcome across those attempts. Given a posterior over arm values, ReMax chooses a sampling distribution that maximizes the posterior expected maximum arm value over $M$ virtual draws. For Gaussian rewards with $K$ arms and any fixed integer $M\ge2$, we characterize optimal sampling distributions through an expected-improvement balance condition and prove an $O(\sqrt{(M-1)KT\log T})$ finite-time bound on expected regret. Our analysis separates a logarithmic contribution from rounds without optimal-arm underestimation and a recovery term that dominates the bound. translated_title: 基于重试的老虎机问题的遗憾分析
translated_abstract: 我们首次对随机多臂老虎机中的 ReMax 算法进行了遗憾分析。ReMax 最初为强化学习而提出，其设计动机源于允许多次尝试时探索所起的作用，并与 pass@$k$ 和 max@$k$ 等基于重试的目标密切相关，这些目标关注多次尝试中的最佳结果。给定臂值的后验分布，ReMax 选择一个采样分布，使其在 $M$ 次虚拟抽取中最大化后验期望的最大臂值。对于具有 $K$ 个臂的高斯奖励以及任意固定整数 $M\ge2$，我们通过期望改进平衡条件刻画了最优采样分布，并证明了期望遗憾的 $O(\sqrt{(M-1)KT\log T})$ 有限时间界。我们的分析将最优臂未被低估的轮次所产生的对数贡献，与主导整个上界的恢复项分离开来。对于每个具有两两不同臂均值的固定实例，我们进一……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文首次对随机多臂老虎机中的 ReMax 算法进行了遗憾分析，通过期望改进平衡条件刻画了最优采样分布，并证明了 $O(\sqrt{(M-1)KT\log T})$ 的有限时间期望遗憾上界。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first regret analysis of ReMax in stochastic multi-armed bandits, characterizes the optimal sampling distributions via an expected-improvement balance condition, and proves a finite-time expected regret bound of $O(\sqrt{(M-1)KT\log T})$.
